label: 🧪 Mocks (sim only)
info:
Pumps mock Victron + Ruuvi sensor values from the simulator container into the 'Daten sammeln' function in the main flow. This tab replaces the role of the Victron + Ruuvi input nodes when there is no Venus OS / dbus available.

Reads values from the simulator's HTTP API:
  GET http://gree.lan:8080/api/sensors

For the dashboard / control logic to react, set values on the simulator dashboard at http://localhost:8080/.

name: Fan out to Daten sammeln
Test: AC ON
info: e2e hook. The dashboard ui-button/ui-switch nodes can't be triggered over the admin /inject API (only plain inject nodes can), so this inject feeds the Gree node directly with an ON command. The e2e suite POSTs to /inject/mock-test-ac-on and asserts the simulator's AC turns on.

name: Test: AC OFF
info: e2e hook — feeds the Gree node directly with an OFF command. See 'Test: AC ON'.
